      VALPortfolio Value
      
          
      
        
      
        
      
          
      
          
      
          
      
            
            
      
          
      
          
      What today's holdings (today's share counts) would have been worth each day. It is not your actual account history: buys and sells along the way aren't counted. SPY and QQQ lines start at the same dollar value so you can compare.
      
        
      
      
      

      
      
        
      RISKHow Bumpy Is It
      Last 12 months of daily moves
      
        
      
          
      
          
      Typical day = one standard deviation of the portfolio's daily move: about two days in three stay inside it. Beta 1.5 means the portfolio has tended to move 1.5% when the S&P 500 moves 1%. Effective stocks = how many equal-sized positions your mix behaves like.
      
        
      
      
      

      
      
        
      CONCWhere the Money Sits
      By today's value
      
        
      
          
      TickerValueWeight
      
        
      
      
      

      
      
        
      CORRDo They Move Together
      1-year daily correlation
      
        
      
          
      
          
      1.00 = always move together, 0 = unrelated, negative = tend to move opposite. Lower numbers between your stocks mean they cushion each other more.
      
        
      
      
      

      
      
        
      DRVWhat Drives Your Swings
      Share of the portfolio's daily ups and downs
      
        
      
          
      TickerWeightYearly volBetaShare of swings
      
          
      A stock can drive more of your swings than its weight when it's jumpy or moves with your other holdings. Yearly vol = typical move over a year (daily standard deviation × √252).
